work_package: M0.1 exact native report arithmetic and F7 online summary reducer

changes.summary: Native fill summaries and linear-equity reconciliation use exact Decimal helpers. NativeReportAccumulator reduces snapshots by timestamp group, incrementally accumulates metrics, fill/funding facts, liquidation state, cashflows, and optional reconciliation.
HistoricalEnvironmentFactory streams compact snapshots to the optional summary reducer and retains only the latest report snapshot in that mode.
Summary-only rollout now wires NativeReportAccumulator into native snapshot collection and restores the factory's prior compaction setting on exit.
Four synthetic regressions cover low-precision turnover/slippage, open/close equity reconciliation, subnormal operands with inherited flags, and fail-closed precision loss.

Seven synthetic parity regressions cover duplicate timestamps and cashflows, exact tail metrics, same-timestamp fill/funding aggregation, snapshot release, reference validation, and open/closed equity reconciliation.

Summary-only rollout parity regression compares account metrics, fill facts, funding, liquidation output, and reconciliation against a retained-report replay; verifies only one report snapshot remains retained.

runtime.environment: NautilusTrader_RL_ES .venv, with RouteB workspace package sources on PYTHONPATH
